files.item: A flyer that advertised the Riots, Massacres and Reform 1700s-1832 history walk.
files.notes: The flyer uses a detail from an engraving depicting the Queen Square, on the Night of the 1831 Bristol riots. The engraving was made from an original drawing by William James Müller (1812–1845).

files.item: Web-poster for the miscellaneous 2019 event series.
files.notes: Featuring a photograph of the Whiteford brothers. The Whiteford brothers were three brothers from St George. During the war, Graham had served in the army; Hubert had been imprisoned as a CO; Wilfred served in the Non-Combatant Corps. In 1919 their father had this photograph taken of his sons. The photograph was also used in a poster advertising the Refusing To Kill exhibition at Bristol Archives, and the cover of the BRHG publication Refusing to Kill.
